viewport_notes: Shopify-hosted; theme controls logo/colors/banner via checkout branding + (Plus) extensions. Judge brand continuity + trust + clarity, not theme code.

checks.rule: no missing-logo, no broken/placeholder images, no Liquid/render errors, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text
checkout logo + accent color + type match the storefront — it reads as the SAME brand, not a generic Shopify default
secure-checkout cue + recognizable payment icons are visible; nothing looks unfinished or untrustworthy at the money step
subtotal / shipping / taxes are legible and not hidden; no surprise-cost ambiguity in the order summary
express options (Shop Pay / wallets) render correctly when present — not clipped or broken

mobile_overlay.rule: form fields + the continue button are ≥44px tall and not crowded; the keyboard doesn't obscure the active field's submit
